findings.rootCause: metaResearchAdapter skipped live Meta Ad Library queries whenever existingPoolCount >= 100 in SQLite, forcing perpetual CACHE_ONLY runs.
findings.fixSummary: Removed existingPoolCount >= 100 suppression gate; implemented explicit ResearchSourceMode (LIVE_WITH_CACHE_FALLBACK, CACHE_ONLY, LIVE_ONLY) with strict LIVE_ONLY cache isolation.

findings.rootCause: 30 ProductDemandObservation rows in prisma/dev.db used evidenceReference='verified-merchant-demand:<domain>' with identical templated values [76, 79, 77, 81, 78, 82] and promotional ad-copy keywords.
findings.fixSummary: Updated evaluateDemandSourceAuthority() and added auditDemandObservationsProvenance() + requalifyAllHistoricalRunsInDb() so merchant-seeded, templated, promotional, and unbacked CSV rows are CACHED_UNVERIFIED (eligibleForEvergreen=false).

findings.rootCause: Searching 'dog' expanded to generic pet queries and admitted cat-only products (Automatic Wet Food Cat Feeder, Pawspick Cat Water Fountain).
findings.fixSummary: Implemented evaluateProductAudienceRelevance() and dedicated 'dog'/'cat' subquery plans in discoveryQueryPlanner.ts; cat-only products are rejected for 'dog' with SPECIES_MISMATCH_CAT_FOR_DOG_QUERY.

findings.rootCause: Clicking a KH-02 shortlist product opened KH-01 Product Intelligence showing '0/100 Weak' without explaining that supplier cost and 6-12m demand were still uncollected.
findings.fixSummary: Updated /api/v1/research/products/[id]/overview and /products/[id]/intelligence to display side-by-side Research Qualification (KH-02) vs Commercial Readiness (KH-01) cards with context-preserving back navigation.

findings.rootCause: Ads mentioning both 'dog' and 'cat' were marked OBSERVED for 'multi-pet households'.
findings.fixSummary: Updated analyzeCustomerPsychology() so 'multi-pet households' is only OBSERVED when multi-pet household ownership is explicitly stated in ad copy; otherwise INFERRED.

findings.rootCause: Rejected candidates could display contradictory text 'Classified as non-physical entity (PHYSICAL_PRODUCT)'.
findings.fixSummary: Implemented structured CandidateRejectionDetail (reasonCode, reasonText, evidenceReferences, detectedEntityType) and sanitizeRejectionOrRealityReason().
